cpu.model: Texas Instruments Sitara AM3358/9, Arm Cortex-A8 (ARMv7-A, 32-bit)

gpu.model: PowerVR SGX530 (graphics only; no AI accelerator, driver support is limited)

storage.details: On-board eMMC (2GB on early revisions, 4GB on Rev C and later) plus a microSD slot.

power.connector: DC barrel jack (5V) or USB mini-B client

firmwareCompatibility.notes: Boots via the on-chip AM335x ROM and U-Boot on eMMC/microSD; firmware is updated by reflashing the MLO/u-boot images rather than a dedicated EEPROM.

_notes: Single-core 1GHz Cortex-A8, 512MB DDR3 and 2x USB 2.0 (one host, one client) are well-established System Reference Manual figures. typicalDrawW=2 is an approximation; BeagleBoard.org cites typical current in the low hundreds of milliamps (~1-2.3W) at 5V, workload-dependent. eMMC size depends on board revision (2GB vs 4GB Rev C).
